lines.text: Habakkuk stands in awe of the LORD's deeds and asks Him to remember mercy in His wrath.
God came from Sinai, and His radiance was like the sunlight, with rays flashing from His hand.
Plague went before God and fever followed Him, and Habakkuk saw the tents of Cushan in distress.
The LORD went forth to save His people and pierced the wicked one's head with a sling stone.
Though the fields fail, Habakkuk will rejoice in the LORD, who makes his feet like those of a deer.
